mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 0.5% signals imminent monetary policy easing during crisis periods, compressing discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate liquidity support.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 0.5% during crisis periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate exceeding 6.5% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending capacity, leading to negative equity returns over the next 20 days as recessionary pressures intensify.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE > 6.5% during economic contractions.

mechanism_narrative: A 10% or greater decline in industrial production signals acute supply chain disruption that suppresses corporate profit margins, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days as recessionary output contraction deepens.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when INDPRO < 95.0 during economic downturns.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts below 800 units and industrial production below 95.0 indicates synchronized demand-supply collapse, triggering negative equity returns over 20 days as recessionary confidence erodes.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when both HOUST < 800 and INDPRO < 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: A 5% or greater decline in real assets (RSAFS) reflects weakening consumer and business spending, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as demand contraction accelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when RSAFS < 340000 during economic slowdowns.

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS at 0.5% combined with CPIAUCSL below 2.5% indicates low-inflation monetary easing, which generates positive equity returns over 5 days as central bank intervention reduces risk premiums.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 0.5% AND CPIAUCSL < 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Negative GDP growth (GDPC1) consistently predicts declining corporate earnings and negative equity returns over 60 days as economic contraction erodes profit visibility.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when GDPC1 growth rate < 0.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts below 800 units and industrial production below 95.0 indicates a dual collapse in construction demand and manufacturing supply, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when both HOUST < 800 and INDPRO < 95.0.
